verdict.rationale: Kit has its own background automation features: 'Unlimited Visual Automations' on the pricing page, RSS campaigns, and broadcasts that can be scheduled to send later. The evidence for them is only thin pricing bullets and a scheduling API line, with no documentation of how automations are triggered or how they run unattended. The MCP and webhook items do not show autonomous background execution, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of automation triggers, actions and workflow behavior; evidence of AI or agent-driven recurring automations; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Draft or schedule to send a broadcast to all or a subset of your subscribers.
